source.title: Call for Applicants - WFC Leader (August 2023)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader.**

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms 24 months and to spend at least 7 hours  per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Basic knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA
* Experience on financial matters, especially bookkeeping and tax filing
* Proficiency in English
* A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties
* Team management capabilities

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until September 18th, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WFC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WFC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2021.6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.6%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support,

translation.title: 招募 WCA 财务委员会负责人（2023 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命新一届**财务委员会（WFC）负责人**。

候选人应完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理委员会工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

* 基本了解 WCA 的组织架构和内部工作流程。
* 有财务工作经验，尤其是记账和报税。
* 英语熟练。
* 每天能安排适当时间履行职责。
* 具备团队管理能力。

申请期从即日起至 2023 年 9 月 18 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
* 担任 WCA 财务委员会负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WFC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2021.6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.6%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 [WCA 议案 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
